charge:
EEOC FORM 5 (11/09)
CHARGE OF DISCRIMINATION
Charge No. 410-2026-10006
EEOC Office: Phoenix District Office
Charging Party: Emerson Pemberton
City/State: Dallas, TX
Respondent: Granite Logistics LLP
DISCRIMINATION BASED ON: Color, National Origin, Religion
DATE(S) DISCRIMINATION TOOK PLACE: Earliest 04/10/2025 Latest 06/17/2025
[X] CONTINUING ACTION
THE PARTICULARS ARE:
1. I was employed by Granite Logistics LLP beginning before April 10, 2025. The conduct
described below began on or about April 10, 2025 and continued through June 17, 2025.
2. I applied for a promotion for which I was qualified and was denied it in favor of a less
experienced employee.
3. I requested a reasonable accommodation and my request was denied without discussion.
4. I believe I have been discriminated against because of my color and national origin and
religion, in violation of applicable federal law.
notice:
U.S. EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY COMMISSION
Phoenix District Office
NOTICE OF CHARGE OF DISCRIMINATION
Date of Notice: 07/26/2025
To: Granite Logistics LLP
Re: Charge No. 410-2026-10006
This is notice that a charge of employment discrimination has been filed against your
organization. No action is required on your part at this time. A position statement may be
requested.
